contribution.position: On the reliability axis, the current evidence does not clear the bar: the fan-out worker had two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms (artifact:incident-log), and the change touches exactly the component with that failure history, yet no chaos experiment has ever been run against it (artifact:ops-runbook). Passing unit/integration results (artifact:test-report, 412 passed, 87% coverage) and in-budget p99 (artifact:perf-report) are necessary but do not exercise the retry-storm failure mode that actually hurt us. Before confidence can attach to reliability, we need a chaos/fault-injection experiment targeting retry behavior under downstream degradation, plus evidence the change does not amplify retry fan-out.
